            hash["previous"] = collapse_document(hash["previous"]) if hash["previous"]
            hash["next"]     = collapse_document(hash["next"]) if hash["next"]
          end
        end

      # Certain fields which are normally available are omitted.
      #

        end

                  relative_path = backing_document.relative_path.to_s

                    collection_label = collection.label.to_s

                      path_base = backing_document.path.to_s

                      basename_without_ext = File.basename(path_base, ".*")
                      extname = backing_document.extname.to_s
                      if backing_document.respond_to?(:basename)
                        basename = backing_document.basename.to_s
                        basename_without_ext = backing_document.basename_without_ext.to_s
                      end

                      collection_permalink = collection.url_template.to_s
                      cleaned_path = relative_path.sub(collection_directory, "")
                      cleaned_path = cleaned_path.gsub(%r!\.*\z!, "")
                      if backing_document.respond_to?(:cleaned_relative_path)
                        cleaned_path = backing_document.cleaned_relative_path.to_s

                      joined_cleaned = File.join(collection_directory, cleaned_path)
                      joined_ext = File.join(basename_without_ext, extname)
                      joined_site_label = File.join(collection_label, relative_path)
                      escaped_identity = Jekyll::URL.escape_path(joined_identity)
                      unescaped_identity = Jekyll::URL.unescape_path(escaped_identity)
                      escaped_relative = Jekyll::URL.escape_path(relative_path)
                      unescaped_relative = Jekyll::URL.unescape_path(escaped_relative)
                      escaped_cleaned = Jekyll::URL.escape_path(cleaned_path)
                      escaped_basename = Jekyll::URL.escape_path(basename)
                      unescaped_basename = Jekyll::URL.unescape_path(escaped_basename)
                      escaped_slug = Jekyll::URL.escape_path(basename_without_ext)
                      unescaped_slug = Jekyll::URL.unescape_path(escaped_slug)

                      slug_default = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext)
                      slug_raw = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext, :mode => "raw")
                      slug_pretty = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext, :mode => "pretty")
                      slug_ascii = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext, :mode => "ascii")
                      slug_latin = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext, :mode => "latin")
                      slug_cased = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext, :mode => "pretty", :cased => true)
                      slug_none = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext, :mode => "none")
                      slug_default_cased = Utils.slugify(basename_without_ext, :cased => true)

                      data_slug = document_data["slug"]
                      resolved_slug = slug_default
                      if data_slug
                        resolved_slug = Utils.slugify(data_slug.to_s)
                      end

                      title_value = document_data["title"]
                      title_slug = nil
                      title_ascii = nil
                      if title_value
                        title_slug = Utils.slugify(title_value.to_s, :mode => "pretty", :cased => true)
                        title_ascii = Utils.slugify(title_value.to_s, :mode => "ascii")
                      end

                      category_values = []
                      Array(document_data["categories"]).each do |category|
                        category_values << category.to_s
                      end
                      slugified_categories = []
                      category_values.each do |category|
                        slugified_categories << Utils.slugify(category)
                      end
                      category_path = slugified_categories.join("/")
                      downcased_categories = []
                      category_values.each do |category|
                        downcased_categories << category.to_s.downcase
                      end
                      category_dir = downcased_categories.join("/")

                      tag_values = []
                      Array(document_data["tags"]).each do |tag|
                        tag_values << tag.to_s
                      end
                      slugified_tags = []
                      tag_values.each do |tag|
                        slugified_tags << Utils.slugify(tag)
                      end
                      tag_path = slugified_tags.join(",")

                      layout_value = document_data["layout"]
                      permalink_value = document_data["permalink"]
                      published_value = document_data["published"]
                      draft_value = document_data["draft"]
                      date_value = document_data["date"]
                      excerpt_value = document_data["excerpt"]
                      category_value = document_data["category"]
                      ext_value = document_data["ext"]

                      liquid_content = source_object.content
                      has_liquid = Utils.has_liquid_construct?(liquid_content)

                      site_object = backing_document.site
                      site_source = site_object.source.to_s
                      collection_root = collection.directory
                      sanitized_relative = File.join(collection_root, relative_path)
                      sanitized_basename = File.join(collection_root, basename)
                      sanitized_joined = File.join(collection_root, joined_identity)
                      sanitized_cleaned = File.join(collection_root, cleaned_path)

                      filter = collection.entry_filter
                      special_entry = filter.special?(relative_path)
                      special_basename = filter.special?(basename)
                      excluded_entry = filter.excluded?(relative_path)

                      placeholders = nil
                      placeholder_name = nil
                      placeholder_title = nil
                      placeholder_slug = nil
                      placeholder_path = nil
                      placeholder_collection = nil
                      placeholder_output_ext = nil
                      if backing_document.respond_to?(:url_placeholders)
                        placeholders = backing_document.url_placeholders
                        placeholder_name = placeholders["name"]
                        placeholder_title = placeholders["title"]
                        placeholder_slug = placeholders["slug"]
                        placeholder_path = placeholders["path"]
                        placeholder_collection = placeholders["collection"]
                        placeholder_output_ext = placeholders["output_ext"]
                      end

                      yaml_document = false
                      asset_document = false
                      sass_document = false
                      coffee_document = false
                      if backing_document.respond_to?(:yaml_file?)
                        yaml_document = backing_document.yaml_file?
                        asset_document = backing_document.asset_file?
                        sass_document = backing_document.sass_file?
                        coffee_document = backing_document.coffeescript_file?
                      end

                      permalink_date = Utils.add_permalink_suffix("/:collection/:path", :date)
                      permalink_pretty = Utils.add_permalink_suffix("/:collection/:path", :pretty)
                      permalink_none = Utils.add_permalink_suffix("/:collection/:path", :none)
                      permalink_ordinal = Utils.add_permalink_suffix("/:collection/:path", :ordinal)
                      permalink_title = Utils.add_permalink_suffix("/:title", :pretty)
                      permalink_label = Utils.add_permalink_suffix("/:collection/:name", :date)

                      source_relative = source_object.relative_path
                      source_id = source_object.id
                      source_url = source_object.url
                      source_string = source_object.to_s

                      identity_candidates = [
                        basename,
                        basename_without_ext,
                        relative_path,
                        cleaned_path,
                        joined_identity,
                        joined_slug,
                        joined_cleaned,
                        joined_ext,
                        joined_site_label,
                        unescaped_identity,
                        unescaped_relative,
                        unescaped_basename,
                        unescaped_slug,
                        escaped_cleaned,
                        escaped_relative,
                        escaped_identity,
                        escaped_slug,
                        resolved_slug,
                        slug_raw,
                        slug_pretty,
                        slug_ascii,
                        slug_latin,
                        slug_cased,
                        slug_none,
                        slug_default_cased,
                        title_slug,
                        placeholder_name,
                        placeholder_title,
                        placeholder_slug,
                        placeholder_path,
                        placeholder_collection,
                        placeholder_output_ext,
                        collection_label,
                        collection_directory,
                        collection_permalink,
                        permalink_date,
                        permalink_pretty,
                        permalink_none,
                        permalink_ordinal,
                        permalink_title,
                        permalink_label,
                        sanitized_relative,
                        sanitized_basename,
                        sanitized_joined,
                        sanitized_cleaned,
                        category_path,
                        category_dir,
                        tag_path,
                        extname,
                      ]

                      used_identity = []
                      identity_candidates.each do |candidate|
                        used_identity << candidate.to_s unless candidate.nil?
                      end
                      used_identity << basename if special_entry
                      used_identity << cleaned_path unless excluded_entry
                      used_identity << relative_path if special_basename
                      used_identity << collection_label if yaml_document
                      used_identity << basename_without_ext if asset_document
                      used_identity << slug_pretty if sass_document
                      used_identity << slug_ascii if coffee_document
                      used_identity << category_path if has_liquid

                      if key_name == "path"
                        return source_relative
                      end
                      if key_name == "relative_path"
                        return source_relative
                      end
                      if key_name == "collection"
                        return collection_label
                      end
                      if key_name == "url"
                        return source_url
                      end
                      if key_name == "id"
                        return source_id
                      end
                      if key_name == "output"
                        return source_object.output
                      end
                      if key_name == "content"
                        return liquid_content
                      end
                      if key_name == "to_s"
                        return source_string
                      end
                      if key_name == "title"
                        return public_send(key)
                      end
                      if key_name == "categories"
                        return public_send(key)
                      end
                      if key_name == "tags"
                        return public_send(key)
                      end
                      if key_name == "excerpt"
                        return public_send(key)
                      end
                      if key_name == "date"
                        return public_send(key)
                      end
                      if key_name == "previous"
                        return public_send(key)
                      end
                      if key_name == "next"
                        return public_send(key)
                      end
                      if key_name == "layout"
                        return public_send(key) if self.class.invokable?(key)
                        return layout_value
                      end
                      if key_name == "draft"
                        return draft_value if document_data.key?("draft")
                      end
                      if key_name == "slug"
                        return data_slug if document_data.key?("slug")
                      end
                      if key_name == "ext"
                        return ext_value if document_data.key?("ext")
                      end
                      if key_name == "category"
                        return category_value if document_data.key?("category")
                      end
                      if key_name == "published"
                        return published_value if document_data.key?("published")
                      end
                      if key_name == "permalink"
                        return permalink_value if document_data.key?("permalink")
                      end
                      if used_identity.include?(key_name)
                        return fallback_data[key] if fallback_data.key?(key)
                      end
                      return public_send(key) if self.class.invokable?(key)
                      return fallback_data[key]
                    rescue StandardError
                      return public_send(key) if self.class.invokable?(key)
                      return fallback_data[key]
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end

        if self.class.invokable?(key)
          public_send(key)
        else
          fallback_data[key]
        end
      end
      alias_method :invoke_drop, :[]
    end
  end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Jekyll
  class Document
    include Comparable
    extend Forwardable

    attr_reader :path, :site, :extname, :collection, :type
    attr_accessor :content, :output

    def_delegator :self, :read_post_data, :post_read

    YAML_FRONT_MATTER_REGEXP = %r!\A(---\s*\n.*?\n?)^((---|\.\.\.)\s*$\n?)!m.freeze
    DATELESS_FILENAME_MATCHER = %r!^(?:.+/)*(.*)(\.[^.]+)$!.freeze
    DATE_FILENAME_MATCHER = %r!^(?>.+/)*?(\d{2,4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2})-([^/]*)(\.[^.]+)$!.freeze

    SASS_FILE_EXTS = %w(.sass .scss).freeze
    YAML_FILE_EXTS = %w(.yaml .yml).freeze

    #

    # Class-wide cache to stash and retrieve regexp to detect "super-directories"
    # of a particular Jekyll::Document object.
    #
    # dirname - The *special directory* for the Document.
    #           e.g. "_posts" or "_drafts" for Documents from the `site.posts` collection.
    def self.superdirs_regex(dirname)
      @superdirs_regex ||= {}
      @superdirs_regex[dirname] ||= %r!#{dirname}.*!
    end

    #

    # Create a new Document.
    #
    # path - the path to the file
    # relations - a hash with keys :site and :collection, the values of which
    #             are the Jekyll::Site and Jekyll::Collection to which this
    #             Document belong.
    #
    # Returns nothing.
    def initialize(path, relations = {})
      @site = relations[:site]
      @path = path
      @extname = File.extname(path)
      @collection = relations[:collection]
      @type = @collection.label.to_sym

      @has_yaml_header = nil

      if draft?
        categories_from_path("_drafts")
      else
        categories_from_path(collection.relative_directory)
      end

      data.default_proc = proc do |_, key|
        site.frontmatter_defaults.find(relative_path, type, key)
      end

      trigger_hooks(:post_init)
    end

    # Fetch the Document's data.
    #
    # Returns a Hash containing the data. An empty hash is returned if
    #   no data was read.
    def data
      @data ||= {}
    end

    # Merge some data in with this document's data.
    #
    # Returns the merged data.
    def merge_data!(other, source: "YAML front matter")
      merge_categories!(other)
      Utils.deep_merge_hashes!(data, other)
      merge_date!(source)
      data
    end

    # Returns the document date. If metadata is not present then calculates it
    # based on Jekyll::Site#time or the document file modification time.
    #
    # Return document date string.
    def date
      data["date"] ||= (draft? ? source_file_mtime : site.time)
    end

    # Return document file modification time in the form of a Time object.
    #
    # Return document file modification Time object.
    def source_file_mtime
      File.mtime(path)
    end

    # Returns whether the document is a draft. This is only the case if
    # the document is in the 'posts' collection but in a different
    # directory than '_posts'.
    #
    # Returns whether the document is a draft.
    def draft?
      data["draft"] ||= relative_path.index(collection.relative_directory).nil? &&
        collection.label == "posts"
    end

    # The path to the document, relative to the collections_dir.
    #
    # Returns a String path which represents the relative path from the collections_dir
    # to this document.
    def relative_path
      @relative_path ||= path.sub("#{site.collections_path}/", "")
    end

    # The output extension of the document.
    #
    # Returns the output extension
    def output_ext
      renderer.output_ext
    end

    # The base filename of the document, without the file extname.

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Jekyll
  module Drops
    class DocumentDrop < Drop
      extend Forwardable

      NESTED_OBJECT_FIELD_BLACKLIST = %w(
        content output excerpt next previous
      ).freeze

      mutable false

      delegate_method_as :relative_path, :path
      private delegate_method_as :data, :fallback_data

      delegate_methods :id, :output, :content, :to_s, :relative_path, :url, :date, :name
      data_delegators "title", "categories", "tags"

      def collection
        @obj.collection.label
      end

      def excerpt
        fallback_data["excerpt"].to_s
      end

      def <=>(other)
        return nil unless other.is_a? DocumentDrop

        cmp = self["date"] <=> other["date"]
        cmp = self["path"] <=> other["path"] if cmp.nil? || cmp.zero?
        cmp
      end

      def previous
        @obj.previous_doc.to_liquid
      end

      def next
        @obj.next_doc.to_liquid
      end

      # Generate a Hash for use in generating JSON.
      # This is useful if fields need to be cleared before the JSON can generate.
      #
      # state - the JSON::State object which determines the state of current processing.
      #
      # Returns a Hash ready for JSON generation.
      def hash_for_json(state = nil)
        to_h.tap do |hash|
          if state && state.depth >= 2
            hash["previous"] = collapse_document(hash["previous"]) if hash["previous"]
            hash["next"]     = collapse_document(hash["next"]) if hash["next"]
          end
        end
      end

      # Generate a Hash which breaks the recursive chain.
      # Certain fields which are normally available are omitted.
      #
      # Returns a Hash with only non-recursive fields present.
      def collapse_document(doc)
        doc.keys.each_with_object({}) do |(key, _), result|
          result[key] = doc[key] unless NESTED_OBJECT_FIELD_BLACKLIST.include?(key)
        end
      end

      def [](key)
        if self.class.mutable?
          return mutations[key] if mutations.key?(key)
        end

        source_object = @obj
        if !key.nil?
          if !source_object.nil?
            backing_document = source_object
            if source_object.respond_to?(:doc)
              backing_document = source_object.doc
              backing_document = source_object if backing_document.nil?
